verdict.stance: Overweight / 20.2% TCR Polish Tier-1 Bank (A- S&P / BBB+ Fitch)
verdict.summary: Poland's #2 bank grew FY25 net profit 10% to PLN 7,015m on PLN 337.9bn assets and lifted Total Capital Ratio to ~20.2% in Q3 2026 after printing two €500m Tier 2 benchmarks (Nov-25 and Jul-26). Minimal CHF mortgage overhang vs peers supports A-/BBB+ ratings.

positives: ~20.2% Q3 2026 Total Capital Ratio and PLN 7.0bn+ earnings power.
Low legacy CHF mortgage exposure vs Polish peers; PZU/PFR state anchor.
negatives: NBP rate-cut cycle normalizing net interest margins from 2025 peaks.
Potential PZU/Pekao group corporate restructuring headlines.
